decision_conditions: 13715-PCO-XX-B1-DR-A-03099 Revision B (Proposed Basement GA Plan); 13715-PCO-XX-00-DR-A-03100 Revision A (Proposed Ground Floor Plan); 13715-PCO-XX-05-DR-A-03105 Revision A (Proposed Fifth Floor Plan); 13715-PCO-XX-RF-DR-A-03106 Revision A (Proposed Roof Plan); 13715-PCO-XX-XX-DR-A-05200 Revision B (Proposed Elevations); 13715-PCO-XX-XX-DR-A-05201 Revision A (Proposed Elevations 03 and 04); 13715-PCO-XX-XX-DR-A-04300 Revision A (Proposed Section AA and BB); 13715-PCO-XX-XX-DR-A-04301 Revision A (Proposed Section CC and DD); Cover Letter dated 10 November 2025; ‘9-11 Northburgh Street and 50-56 Great Sutton Street NMA November 2025’ Design Document by Piercy & Company.
description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref. P2023/2609/FUL dated 27/03/2024 (as amended by P2024/1454/NMA dated 09/08/2024 and P2024/3557/NMA dated 04/02/2025) (‘Alterations to existing building comprising the construction of a new fifth floor extension for office floorspace at 9 - 11 Northburgh Street, new external cladding and facades facing Great Sutton Street and Northburgh Street, replacement of roof coverings and all windows with double glazed units, [removal of two stair cores and replacement of passenger lifts; relocation of M&E central plant to the basement; comprehensive refurbishment of reception space,] improvements to external courtyard and amenity spaces, and associated refuse and cycle storage.’) in order to amend ground floor entrance doors and fire escape, GRC column casing, re-configure roof lights and omit roof ducts and install dry risers and pipes at roof level, amend balustrade to L01 terrace, amend internal layouts and basement and ground floor levels and associated minor façade changes.
